description: Every pinned numerical cross-check in the OpenDose test suite and docs/prism-validation.md: the quantity, the value OpenDose is held to, the reference value, the tolerance and where the reference comes from. Each file entry points at the assertion that enforces it (engine/tests/ runs on every change). Where a test compares against a library at run time, ours reads computed at test time.

groups.Prism screenshot: Numbers read off GraphPad Prism results sheets for the same data (docs/prism-validation.md).
groups.NIST StRD: Certified values from the NIST Statistical Reference Datasets.
groups.Statistics guide example: Worked examples from the GraphPad statistics guide, user guide and FAQ.
groups.Published example: Worked examples from textbooks, papers and software documentation.
groups.statsmodels: Agreement with statsmodels, computed side by side when the tests run.
groups.pingouin: Agreement with pingouin, computed side by side when the tests run.
groups.R: Values printed in R package documentation.
groups.SciPy: Agreement with independent SciPy routines, computed when the tests run.
